build_transformer_model: build a Transformer model with tensor parallelism using ModelArgs and an optional DeviceMesh
create_modelargs_config: create a ModelArgs dataclass to configure dim, n_layers, n_heads, vocab_size, and rope settings
create_ropeargs_config: create a RopeArgs dataclass to configure theta, scaled rope, and frequency factors
build_transformerblock: build a TransformerBlock with Attention, FeedForward, and RMSNorm layers for tensor parallel inference
review_attention_layer: review the Attention class with wq, wk, wv, wo linear layers for tensor parallel head splitting
